description: This file defines the class BridgeRefreshCompletedEvent, which models a specific Zigbee cluster command event related to bridge refresh completion in a mock Zigbee device simulation. It extends ClusterCommandEvent and constructs the event with specific identifiers, including the manufacturer ID and command ID.

classes.name: BridgeRefreshCompletedEvent
classes.description: Represents a Zigbee cluster command event indicating a bridge refresh has been completed.

methods.name: BridgeRefreshCompletedEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with cluster-specific identifiers.

methods.name: getCommandPayload
methods.description: Returns an empty byte array representing the payload for this command.
